entries.title: Standard shipping (India)
entries.answer: Standard shipping inside India takes 5–7 business days after dispatch and costs ₹79.

entries.title: Express shipping (India)
entries.answer: Express shipping inside India takes 2–3 business days after dispatch and costs ₹199.

entries.title: Free shipping threshold
entries.answer: Shipping is free on prepaid orders of ₹1,499 or more inside India. COD orders never get free shipping.

entries.title: Tracking
entries.answer: A tracking link is emailed and SMSed within 24 hours of dispatch. Status updates come from the courier, not from Fern & Thread chat.

entries.title: Monsoon and festival delays
entries.answer: During monsoon (June–September) and Diwali week, add 2 extra business days to every shipping estimate.

entries.title: Return window
entries.answer: You may request a return within 30 days of delivery. The request must be opened from the order page.

entries.title: Return condition
entries.answer: Returned items must be unworn, unwashed, and have the original tags attached. Innerwear and face masks cannot be returned.

entries.title: Refund timeline
entries.answer: Once we receive the return, prepaid refunds go back to the original payment method in 5–7 business days. COD returns are refunded as store credit in 7–10 business days.

entries.title: Exchange vs return
entries.answer: Size exchanges are free once per order if the replacement is in stock. A return-for-refund uses one of your two free return pickups per calendar year; extra pickups cost ₹99.

entries.title: Tops size chart
entries.answer: Tops: S 34–36 in chest, M 38–40, L 42–44, XL 46–48. Charts are body measurements, not garment measurements.

entries.title: Bottoms size chart
entries.answer: Bottoms: S 28–30 in waist, M 32–34, L 36–38, XL 40–42. Inseams are 28 in (short), 30 in (regular), 32 in (long).

entries.title: Between sizes
entries.answer: If you are between sizes, size up for linen and size down for stretch jersey. Linen relaxes after the first wash; jersey does not.

entries.title: Payment methods
entries.answer: We accept UPI, Visa, Mastercard, RuPay, and net banking. We do not accept American Express or international cards on the Indian checkout.

entries.title: Failed payment
entries.answer: A failed payment does not place an order. The bank hold, if any, drops in 3–5 business days. Try a different UPI app or card; we cannot release a bank hold ourselves.

entries.title: GST invoice
entries.answer: A GST invoice is emailed in PDF within 24 hours of payment. To add a GSTIN, enter it at checkout; it cannot be added after dispatch.

entries.title: Reset password
entries.answer: Use Forgot password on the login page. The reset link expires in 30 minutes and can be requested three times per day.

entries.title: Change address
entries.answer: You may change the delivery address until the order is marked Packed. After Packed, the courier has the label and we cannot redirect it.

entries.title: Order history
entries.answer: Signed-in buyers see two years of orders under Account → Orders. Guest checkout orders are only in the confirmation email.

entries.title: International shipping
entries.answer: We ship to UAE, Singapore, and Germany only. International shipping takes 8–12 business days and starts at ₹1,290. Duties are paid by the buyer.

entries.title: Sale items
entries.answer: Final-sale and warehouse-sale items can be exchanged for size only. They cannot be refunded to the original payment method.

entries.title: Kids sizes
entries.answer: Kids tops: 3–4y 56 cm height, 5–6y 116 cm, 7–8y 128 cm. Kids items use height, not chest.

entries.title: Cash on delivery
entries.answer: COD is available on Indian orders under ₹5,000 and adds a ₹49 fee. COD is not available for international checkouts or for custom embroidery.

entries.title: Delete account
entries.answer: Email privacy@fernandthread.example from the same address as the account. Deletion completes in 14 days and cannot be undone. Open orders must finish or be cancelled first.
